# RC Car King

> Research-led RC vehicle buying guides. Publisher: RC Car King; founder/editor: Aleksandar Spasevski. The Garage Editor is the house voice, not an invented hands-on tester.

Current reviews cover complete cars and body-inclusive kits. Editorial ratings describe buyer fit, not measured performance or Amazon customer stars. Amazon links are affiliate links; offers expire after 24 hours.

## Publication
- [About](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/about/): Aleksandar’s story and editorial identity.
- [Method](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/methodology/): Sources, ratings and evidence policy.
- [Privacy Policy](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/privacy-policy/): How RC Car King handles optional Google Analytics, cookie choices, hosting requests, Google Fonts, Amazon affiliate links and messages.
- [Terms of Service](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/terms-of-service/): Terms for using RC Car King's research-led reviews, editorial ratings, affiliate links and credited media, including purchase responsibilities and corrections.
- [Site map](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/sitemap/): All published pages and review archives.
- [XML sitemap index](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/sitemap_index.xml)

## Guides and listicles
- [Guides](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/guides/)
- [Listicles](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/listicles/)
- [RC car inspection checklist: before and after a run](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/guides/rc-car-pre-run-post-run-checklist/): Inspect your electric RC car before and after driving: wheels, wiring, battery retention, debris, body access and model-specific maintenance decisions.
- [RC car differentials: open, locked and center explained](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/guides/rc-car-differentials-open-locked-center/): Understand open, locked and center RC differentials, with exact vehicle examples, a drivetrain audit and practical checks before changing your setup.
- [RC crawler geometry: wheelbase, clearance and obstacle lines](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/guides/rc-crawler-wheelbase-ground-clearance/): Understand RC crawler wheelbase, approach, breakover and ground clearance. Read exact TRX-4M Defender and K10 examples, then plan a sensible obstacle line.
- [RC car steers but won’t move: what to check first](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/guides/rc-car-steers-but-wont-move/): RC car steers but will not drive? Follow a safe diagnostic sequence, distinguish cutoff from setup faults, and read exact-model LED codes before replacing parts.
- [5 small RC cars for home and compact outdoor spaces](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/listicles/small-rc-cars-home-compact-outdoor-spaces/): Compare five small RC cars by driving space: indoor racing, hard-floor drifting, crawling and compact dirt. Exact SKUs, equipment gaps and dated costs.
- [Brushed vs brushless RC cars: what actually changes?](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/guides/brushed-vs-brushless-rc-cars/): Learn brushed vs brushless RC motor basics, Kv and sensored control. Compare exact complete-car examples, maintenance needs and compatibility questions.
- [RTR vs kit RC cars: what is actually included?](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/guides/rtr-vs-kit-rc-car-whats-included/): Understand RTR, Readyset and body-inclusive RC kits. Check radios, batteries, chargers, paint and total startup needs with four exact-model examples.
- [Can RC cars run on grass? Match the car to your terrain](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/guides/rc-cars-grass-terrain-guide/): Choose RC terrain by grass height, ground clearance, tires and space. Includes exact Kyosho, ARRMA and Traxxas examples, checks and troubleshooting.
- [RC steering trim, dual rate and gyro: a first-run setup guide](https://alekspasseo.github.io/rc-car-king/guides/rc-steering-trim-dual-rate-gyro/): Set up RC steering in the right order: direction, trim, dual rate and gyro. Includes exact-model examples, troubleshooting and a first-run checklist.
